question:
**Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word**.

Ample
solution:
The correct answer is **'Scarce'**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Ample** means enough or more than enough.

** • Example-** *There is space for an** ample** car park.*

 
• Marked option **Scarce** means not existing in large quantities; hard to find.

** • Example-** *Fresh vegetables were **scarce** during the drought.*

 
• It is clear that **Ample** and **Scarce** are opposite in meaning.

Therefore the correct answer is **option 4.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Enough** means as much or as many of something as necessary.
 
• **Plenty** means an adequate or more than an adequate number or amount of something.
 
• **Spare** means not needed now but kept because it may be needed in the future.
